description.value: The Mary Winspear Centre is a 30,000 sq ft non-profit community and performing arts venue in Sidney, BC, hosting theatre productions, concerts, art exhibitions, conferences, and community celebrations. Operated by the Saanich Peninsula Memorial Park Society, the wheelchair-accessible facility includes the Charlie White Theatre, Bodine Family Hall, an art gallery, and meeting rooms. Situated close to the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal and with a seaside setting, it is a cultural hub for visitors arriving on the Saanich Peninsula by bike or ferry.
